cities.name: Oslo

interests.name: Urban Culture & Modern Architecture 🏙️
interests.description: Striking modern buildings, clean Scandinavian design and cultural landmarks.

interests.name: Museums & History 🖼️
interests.description: Fortresses, national museums and deep Norwegian history.

interests.name: Parks & Waterfront Walks 🌿
interests.description: Massive sculpture park, quiet greenery and calm paths perfect for sunsets.

cities.local_food_tip: Try seafood, fresh salmon, open-faced sandwiches and local breads — simple but fresh Scandinavian flavours. 🐟🍞🥗
cities.full_day: Morning: ☀️ Walk the roof of Oslo Opera House → Explore Akershus Fortress with harbor views → ☕ Coffee & pastry near Karl Johans Gate. Afternoon: 🖼️ Choose a museum: National Museum, Vigeland Museum or Maritime Museum → 🍽️ Seafood lunch at Aker Brygge. Sunset: 🌇 Stroll through Vigeland Park or the harbor promenade. Night: 🌃 Relaxed dinner in Tjuvholmen district or a calm waterfront walk.

ideas: 🌸 Parks and waterfront begin to bloom — perfect for mild strolls.
🎨 Museums reopen fully for spring cultural season.
☕ Outdoor cafés appear along the harbor and city center.
🌞 Long daylight hours — perfect for fjord walks and museums.
🍦 Ice cream and relaxed waterside evenings.
🌅 Beautiful late sunsets along Aker Brygge and Tjuvholmen.
🍁 Vigeland Park turns golden — great autumn photos.
🏛️ Indoor museums perfect for chilly days.
❄️ Snowy harbor and calm winter atmosphere.
☕ Hot drinks and warm meals in cozy Nordic restaurants.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚇 Use Ruter metro, trams and buses to reach all main neighborhoods and attractions.
🕒 Plan your trip and check delays with Ruter’s online journey planner.
📱 Download the Ruter app for live departures and mobile tickets.
🚢 Ferries in the Oslofjord are part of the Ruter network — great mini-cruises using the same tickets.

city_events.name: Oslo Summer Waterfront Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Music, street performances, open-air markets and waterfront vibes under long summer days.

recommended_places.name: Oslo Opera House
recommended_places.why_visit: Walkable sloped roof with fjord views and iconic architecture.

recommended_places.name: Vigeland Park
recommended_places.why_visit: The world’s largest sculpture park by a single artist — peaceful and stunning.

hidden_gems.name: Damstredet & Telthusbakken
hidden_gems.description: Tiny colorful wooden streets that feel like stepping back in time.

hidden_gems.name: Tjuvholmen Sculpture Park
hidden_gems.description: Waterfront sculpture park with sea views and modern architecture.

hidden_gems.name: Ekebergparken
hidden_gems.description: Hilltop sculpture park with panoramic views over Oslo.

cities.name: Bergen

interests.name: Fjords & Mountains 🌄
interests.description: Gateway to fjord adventures, mountain hikes and dramatic Norwegian scenery.

interests.name: Historic Harbor & UNESCO Bryggen 🏘️
interests.description: Old wooden merchant houses, narrow alleys and signature Bergen charm.

interests.name: Seafood & Coastal Cuisine 🐟
interests.description: Fresh seafood markets, salmon dishes and traditional local flavors.

cities.local_food_tip: Try salmon, shrimp sandwiches, seafood soups, warm bread and Scandinavian pastries — perfect after fjord trips.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🚤 Take a fjord cruise from Bergen Harbor → Explore Bryggen → ☕ Coffee by the harbor. Afternoon: ⛰️ Ride the Fløibanen Funicular to Mount Fløyen → 🍽️ Lunch at harbor cafés. Sunset: 🌇 View from Fløyen or Mount Ulriken. Night: 🌃 Evening walk around Bryggen.

ideas: 🌿 Fresh green slopes and early-season fjord trips.
🚤 Quiet boat rides before summer crowds.
🏞️ Fjord cruises and mountain hikes in ideal weather.
🍽️ Seafood meals outdoors by the harbor.
🛶 Long daylight perfect for exploring nature.
🍂 Fjord landscapes in deep orange tones.
🔥 Warm soups and pastries after rainy walks.
❄️ Snow on surrounding mountains + calm fjord views.
🏔️ Winter rides on Fløibanen or Ulriken.
🔥 Cozy fish soups and warm cafés.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Use Skyss buses and light rail (Bybanen) to move between the city center, airport and suburbs.
🎟️ Check tickets and zone information on Skyss before you travel.
📱 The Skyss Ticket app lets you buy tickets and see departures on your phone.
🚤 For some fjord routes, combine Skyss with organised boat tours from the harbor.

city_events.name: Bergen International Festival
city_events.description: 🎶 Music, culture and performances across the city.

recommended_places.name: Bryggen
recommended_places.why_visit: UNESCO wooden wharf with colorful houses and historic alleyways.

recommended_places.name: Fløibanen Funicular
recommended_places.why_visit: Fast ride to panoramic views and scenic walking trails.

recommended_places.name: Bergen Fish Market
recommended_places.why_visit: Fresh seafood, pastries, warm dishes and lively atmosphere.

hidden_gems.name: Skansen Fire Station Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: Small hilltop viewpoint overlooking the harbor.

hidden_gems.name: Old Bergen Museum (Gamle Bergen)
hidden_gems.description: Open-air museum with historic houses and peaceful surroundings.

hidden_gems.name: Mount Sandviksfjellet
hidden_gems.description: Less touristy mountain with amazing fjord views.

cities.name: Stavanger

interests.name: Coastal Town & Sea Life 🌊
interests.description: Colorful waterfront, harborside cafés and lively seaside atmosphere.

interests.name: Gateway to Fjords & Cliffs (Lysefjord / Preikestolen) 🏞️
interests.description: Access to Norway’s dramatic fjord landscapes and the iconic Preikestolen cliff.

interests.name: Historic Old Town & Street Art 🎨
interests.description: Charming white wooden houses and strong creative street-art scene.

cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood, salmon, coastal stews and Norwegian-style fish dishes — light, warm and ideal after fjord excursions.
cities.full_day: Morning: ⛵ Start at Stavanger Harbour → Take a boat trip into Lysefjord → ☕ Coffee in old-town cafés. Afternoon: 🥾 Visit or hike near Preikestolen → 🍽️ Seafood lunch near the harbor. Sunset: 🌇 Coastal walk at Solastranden Beach. Night: 🌙 Dinner by the water and stroll through historic streets.

ideas: 🌤️ Calm fjord waters — perfect for early-season cruises.
🚶 Explore quiet wooden old town before summer crowds.
⛵ Fjord cruising, kayaking and beach visits.
🍂 Golden coastal scenery — great for photography.
🔥 Warm seafood stews after windy days.
🌧️ Stormy seas and fjord mist for dramatic nature.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Use Kolumbus buses and boats for travel in Stavanger and the Rogaland region.
🎟️ Check Kolumbus ticket options before heading to suburbs or beaches like Solastranden.
📱 The Kolumbus app lets you plan routes and buy mobile tickets.
🚢 For Lysefjord and Preikestolen boat trips, look at Kolumbus and local fjord tour operators.

city_events.name: Stavanger Coastal & Fjord Festival
city_events.description: 🌊 Boat tours, fjord hikes, seafood and coastal celebrations.

recommended_places.name: Gamle Stavanger (Old Town)
recommended_places.why_visit: Charming wooden houses and preserved historic district.

recommended_places.name: Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock)
recommended_places.why_visit: One of Norway’s most iconic fjord views.

recommended_places.name: Solastranden Beach
recommended_places.why_visit: Beautiful sandy beach with sunset views.

hidden_gems.name: Øvre Holmegate (The Colour Street)
hidden_gems.description: Bright, colorful street full of cafés and art.

hidden_gems.name: Sverd i Fjell
hidden_gems.description: Monument of giant Viking swords by the fjord.

hidden_gems.name: Flor & Fjære Garden Island
hidden_gems.description: Colorful botanical island reached by boat.

cities.name: Tromsø

interests.name: Arctic Nature & Northern Lights 🌌
interests.description: Perfect place for aurora viewing and Arctic landscapes.

interests.name: Winter Adventures & Arctic Wildlife ❄️
interests.description: Dog sledding, fjord safaris and snow activities.

cities.local_food_tip: Fresh Arctic fish (cod, salmon), warm soups and Nordic dishes — perfect after cold-weather outings.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit Arctic Cathedral → Walk the harbor → ☕ Cozy café. Afternoon: Ride Fjellheisen Cable Car → 🍽️ Seafood lunch. Sunset: 🌇 Boat ride for Arctic golden hour. Night: 🌌 Winter: Northern Lights tours. Summer: Midnight Sun walks.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚍 Local buses connect Tromsø center with suburbs, the cable car and key viewpoints.
📱 Use the Entur journey planner (web or app) for all Norwegian public transport, including Tromsø.
🛳️ Ferries and boats are great for fjord and island trips around Tromsø.
🚐 For Northern Lights and wildlife excursions, organised tours usually include their own transport.

city_events.name: Tromsø Northern Lights Festival
city_events.description: 🎼 Classical & modern music under Arctic sky.

recommended_places.name: Arctic Cathedral
recommended_places.why_visit: Iconic Arctic architecture with fjord backdrop.

recommended_places.name: Fjellheisen Cable Car
recommended_places.why_visit: Best viewpoint for fjords, sunset & aurora.

hidden_gems.name: Telegrafbukta Beach
hidden_gems.description: Peaceful beach with great views in all seasons.

hidden_gems.name: Prestvannet Lake
hidden_gems.description: Calm lake ideal for nature walks and aurora viewing.

hidden_gems.name: Skansen Historic Area
hidden_gems.description: Atmospheric historic area near the old fortress.

cities.name: Trondheim

interests.name: Historic Architecture & Nordic Heritage 🏰
interests.description: Historic cathedral, old wooden districts and waterfront charm.

interests.name: Coastal & Fjord Access 🌊
interests.description: Easy access to fjord views, waterfront walks and seaside parks.

interests.name: Student & Youth Culture 🌿
interests.description: Lively neighborhoods, cafés and outdoor-friendly atmosphere.

cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fish, local produce, breads and Norwegian comfort dishes — perfect after city or nature walks.
cities.full_day:
Morning: Explore historic center & cathedral → ☕ Bakery break.

Afternoon: Walk along the fjord coast or nature trails → 🍽️ Local seafood lunch.

Sunset: 🌇 Fjord viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Student cafés, concerts and relaxed atmosphere.

ideas: 🏙️ Perfect for wandering the old town.
🎭 Fewer crowds — ideal for history lovers.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Use AtB buses for getting around Trondheim and nearby areas.
🚆 Regional trains connect Trondheim with other Norwegian cities along the coast and inland.
📱 AtB’s journey planning tools and app show real-time departures.
🚤 For fjordside trips, check local boat and ferry routes that connect small communities.

city_events.name: Trondheim Summer Coast Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Music, culture, coastal activities and community celebrations.
